title: Milroy cipher telegrams (Cox 3 Dec 1862, Bascom 4 Dec 1861): found solved by Richard Bean, 2026

documents.shelfmark: Milroy's copy, transcribed in the Jasper County Library lesson plan

plaintext.source: Richard Bean with Claude Opus 5 (2026), on cryptiana https://cryptiana.web.fc2.com/code/civilwar1b_milroy.htm

transcription.source: Jasper County Library lesson plan (Milroy's own copy)
transcription.notes: Count is the words of the raw string in route.py after the indicator 'China' and a '-' are removed, counted with split(), not with _check_profile.py --measure. NOTES call the transcription unreliable; the grid also holds nulls and code words.

system.summary: Stager Cipher No. 7: word route transposition on six fixed columns, the indicator word giving the number of lines, columns entered in a set sequence up or down, with nulls and code words.
system.notes: Indicator words from Bean's solution: China = 8 lines, Turkey = 12, Austria = 9. The Bascom telegram (4 Dec 1861) was not handled here.

prior_solution.where: cryptiana unsolved list marks it Solved: Richard Bean with Claude Opus 5, 2026 (civilwar1b_milroy.htm)

solution.what: cryptiana's unsolved list (fetched 2026-09-14) marks the item Solved by Richard Bean with Claude Opus 5, 2026.
Spot check on Milroy's copy: 'imboden by to forward' is column 6 rows 1-4 downward and 'what is if' column 1 rows 3-1 upward, consistent with Bean's grid.
Blind word-bigram search over all 6-column routes (route.py) did not converge: unreliable transcription, nulls and code words. Not pursued.

outcome.method_basis: Richard Bean's solution (cryptiana, 2026) was known before the attempt and spot-checked on two routes of Milroy's copy; the project's own blind route search did not converge.
outcome.notes: Solved by Bean 2026; only spot-checked here, nothing added; key state is Bean's. README lists it among entries solved by others and not counted in the results.
